comments.body:
Former user, If you could provide some suggestions as to how to embed this information in the vocabularies, that would be helpful.
Thanks.

I think the best properties for this are owl:versionInfo to record the current version and owl:priorVersion to link to the previous version, e.g.:

<owl:priorVersion rdf:resource="http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/2014/11/27/repository#"/>
<owl:versionInfo>v4/2015/02/04</owl:versionInfo>

There's more info at http://www.w3.org/TR/2004/REC-owl-guide-20040210/#OntologyHeaders and http://www.w3.org/TR/owl-ref/#Ontology-def

I've been out of this for awhile.

Can someone clarify if the current version of the ontologies are backwards compatible with the previous one.

edit: or alternatively is specifying backwards compatibility not something your are either a) interested in maintaining or b) concerned about with in your use.
